acceptance.criterion: retry(fn, n) returns the first successful result of fn()
acceptance.check:
python3 -c "from rt import retry
c = [0]
def f():
    c[0] += 1
    if c[0] < 3:
        raise ValueError
    return 1
assert retry(f, 5) == 1 and c[0] == 3"

acceptance.criterion: fn is called at most n times, and the last exception is re-raised when every attempt fails
retry(fn, 0) raises ValueError without calling fn

checks.command:
python3 -c "from rt import retry
c = [0]
def f():
    c[0] += 1
    if c[0] < 3:
        raise ValueError
    return 1
assert retry(f, 5) == 1 and c[0] == 3"

diff --git a/rt.py b/rt.py

 def retry(fn, attempts):
-    raise NotImplementedError
